claims.claim: The item is a center table and TV console.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a brown wooden TV stand with cabinets and open shelves and a flat-screen TV on it; no separate center table is shown.
Photos show appearance but not usage history or wear.
Photos cannot reveal internal repairs or whether the TV was opened.
The TV is not shown running, so overheating cannot be observed.
Ports cannot be tested from still photos.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Neither pads nor receipt appear in the photos.
Seller's motive cannot be confirmed from the image.

risks.proof: Video of the TV powering on and showing a stable picture.

risks.risk: Screen has scratches, cracks, or dead pixels.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the screen both on and off.
Photo of the remote control with the TV.

risks.risk: Drawers, doors, or shelves are broken or stiff.
risks.proof: Video opening and closing every cabinet door, drawer, and shelf.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as stand hardware not working.

risks.risk: Power cord and cables are missing.
risks.proof: Photo of all cables and the power cord.

risks.risk: Original pads and UK receipt are not included.
risks.proof: Photo of the pads and receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as without pads and receipt.

risks.risk: Age or usage history is heavy.
risks.proof: Original receipt or proof of purchase date.

proof_requests: Video of the TV turning on and displaying an image.
Close-up photos of the TV screen on and off.
Video of all cabinet doors, drawers, and shelves opening and closing.
Photo of all cables and power cords.
Photo of the original pads and UK receipt.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a TV stand with flat-screen TV, so it can be priced at its worst case while awaiting proof of condition and accessories.
